title: Hold a real estate agent licence
what: Hold a real estate agent licence before carrying on business as a real estate agent.

sources.title: Agents Act 2003 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 18(1) (current republication (R45, from 6 December 2025; Agents Act 2003 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person is not a licensed real estate agent; and (b) the person— (i) carries on business as a real estate agent; or (ii) pretends to be a licensed real estate agent.

sources.title: Agents Act 2003 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 33, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current republication (R45, from 6 December 2025; Agents Act 2003 | Acts)
sources.quote: The commissioner for fair trading must issue the licence if satisfied that the applicant is eligible to be licensed under section 24 (Eligibility for licences).
